summary: Examples: 32768 | root(5) is 8, 4 | root is 2, and me | root(3) for cube root.
questions: What's an example of the root filter?
How do I get a cube root?

answer_card.title: root examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
fiveroot: "{{ 32768 | root(5) }}"   # 8
sqrt_of_2: "{{ 4 | root }}"          # 2
cuberoot_me: "{{ me | root(3) }}"
```
